name: ListItem
usage: Conversation lists, member lists, file list rows, search results, access records

props.name: description
props.description: Description on the second line (truncated to one line).

props.name: leading
props.description: Left side: an avatar, icon or thumbnail.

props.name: meta
props.description: Faint information at the top right: time, count, status.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions on the right (IconButton and the like).

props.name: actionsOnHover
props.description: Shows the actions only on hover or keyboard focus, keeping the list calm.

props.name: selected
props.description:
Selected state (the item currently open in a split view). With `onClick`, screen readers announce it as a
pressed button (`aria-pressed`).

props.name: current
props.description:
The current item, such as the page being shown in a list of links or the open conversation: it looks selected
and is announced as current (`aria-current`, `page` for a link with `href`).

props.name: href
props.description:
Turns the whole row into a link to this address (`<a>`): it can be opened in a new tab and its address copied.
Focused with `Tab` and followed with `Enter`. With `onClick` as well, `onClick` runs first; call
`event.preventDefault()` there for client-side routing.

props.name: onClick
props.description:
Click on the whole row; when provided (without `href`), the body is a button that can be focused with `Tab`
and triggered with `Enter` or `Space`.

props.name: density
props.description: Row density: `comfortable` suits conversations and members; `compact` suits files and tree-like entries.

examples.name: CompactWithActions
examples.title: Compact row with actions on hover
examples.description: A file list: compact density, and the actions appear only on hover.

examples.name: Links
examples.title: Links and the current item
examples.description:
With `href`, each row is a link (it can be opened in a new tab); `current` marks the page being shown, for
screen readers too (`aria-current="page"`).

examples.name: States
examples.title: Selected and unread
examples.description: Use `selected` for the item currently open in a split view; put the unread count in `meta`.
